description: Scale generator: builds a seven-note modal scale from a root and a mode, puts it out as a polyphonic 1V/oct signal, and quantises four separate pitches to it

params.text: Sets the root note of the scale over a range of -4V to 4V, rounded to the nearest semitone, with 0V giving C4
Chooses the mode: major at -4V, then Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, minor and Locrian at 2V, and anything above 2V gives Locrian although the knob turns to 4V

inputs.text: Sets the root note of the scale in place of the Root knob while a cable is patched, read as 1V/oct and rounded to the nearest semitone
Chooses the mode in place of the Mode knob while a cable is patched, one mode per volt from -4V, with everything above 2V giving Locrian
A monophonic pitch to be rounded to the nearest note of the current scale; the quantised pitch appears at the Out jack paired with it, and nothing is quantised unless that output is patched too

outputs.text: The seven notes of the current scale as a polyphonic 1V/oct signal, one note per channel, starting at the root
Carries the pitch at the In jack paired with it, rounded to the nearest note of the current scale; it stays at 0V unless both that input and this output are patched

notes: the display names the scale being built, root and mode together, and it takes no click
a quantiser pair does nothing unless both its In jack and the Out jack beside it are patched; with only the input patched the output stays at 0V and no rounding happens
